_about: Sessellift Stern T-3 fixed-grip triple: the Stern Q-4 at a 12 ft line gauge (owner, 2026-11-02, as the FGQ-4's doubles and triples, LD5). The hood, piers, column, boom and decks keep the quad's size; the arms, crossbeams, lifting portals, sheave rows and bullwheel plates follow the gauge (assets/stern_heads.py). The chairs are the FGQ-4 family's. Millimetres.
